title: Deckhand Message Envelope
description: Every Deckhand WebSocket message (text frame, UTF-8 JSON) MUST conform to this envelope. See SRD Section 7.2.

id.description: Sender-generated unique identifier for this message within the session.

reply_to.description: Optional. The 'id' of the request message being answered.

ts.description: Sender wall clock in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Informational only — never used for security decisions.

payload.description: Message-type-specific payload. May be empty ({}) for messages with no data. Unknown fields MUST be ignored (PROTO-002).
